title: revision plan 2026b closed; plan 2026c with markers OPEN_RG/CLOSED_RG and a checking tool
author: Claude-JG
description: Plan 2026b got messy - keep the short information in the plan and move the rest to the log; a new plan 2026c whose steps start with **OPEN_RGx.y** or **CLOSED_RGx.y** and a title saying what is done, four fixed sections (how to, next steps, open steps, groups), the open steps and the groups written by a tool docs/revision/planManager.py that also checks the plan (order, duplicates, headings, references, next steps) and adds and changes steps; the open steps of 2026b moved, groups 12 to 18 into misc
releaseNotes: revision plan 2026b closed (one line per step, the texts in its log); plan 2026c with steps as headings **OPEN_RGx.y** / **CLOSED_RGx.y**, four fixed sections, and docs/revision/planManager.py to check it, write its generated parts and add and change steps; the open steps carried over, groups 12 to 18 into misc. revision2026c step RG10.30
